includes indicators for compulsory schooling and pre-school/Kindergarten coverage in Hesse during the 1960s."},{"title":"School and Education Statistics in Hesse 1945-1970","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8392","justification":"Hesse-specific dataset with administrative education statistics; includes primary and lower-secondary school enrolment under compulsory education and pre-school institutions in the 1950s and 1960s."},{"title":"Pre-school and Kindergarten Provision in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1950-1970","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8351","justification":"Covers development of pre-school and Kindergarten in West Germany with breakdowns by Land; allows analysis of pre-school provision in Hesse during the 1960s."},{"title":"German Education Council Data on School Structures 1965-1975","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8230","justification":"Includes documentation of school structure reforms, compulsory schooling ages, and expansion of pre-school education across Länder, including Hesse in the late 1960s."},{"title":"Microcensus (Scientific Use File) – Education and Training, 1962","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1234","justification":"Household survey with education variables, including school attendance of children; regional identifiers can be used to focus on Hesse and study participation under compulsory schooling in the early 1960s."},{"title":"Microcensus (Scientific Use File) – Education and Training, 1966","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1366","justification":"Similar to 1962 Microcensus; allows analysis of school attendance and early education participation by Land, including Hesse, mid-1960s."},{"title":"Microcensus (Scientific Use File) – Education and Training, 1969","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1469","justification":"Late-1960s Microcensus with education details; suitable for assessing coverage of compulsory schooling and pre-school attendance in Hesse at the end of the decade."},{"title":"Educational Expansion in West Germany: Regional Time Series 1950-1980","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8201","justification":"Provides Länder-level time series on enrolment and educational transitions; includes Hesse and allows reconstruction of compulsory schooling participation during the 1960s."},{"title":"Kindergarten and Early Childhood Education in West Germany: Länder Data 1955-1975","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8320","justification":"Focuses on early childhood education; includes numbers of Kindergartens, places, and participation by Land, enabling detailed study of pre-school education in Hesse during the 1960s."}]}
